title: The Church's One Foundation
lyrics_original: From heaven He came and sought her
With His own blood He bought her
And for her life He died.
Yet one o'er all the earth;
One Lord, one faith, one birth;
And to one hope she presses,
Is with her to the end:
Though there be those who hate her,
And false sons in her pale,
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song!
Shall be the Church at rest.
Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
With those whose rest is won,
Lord, give us grace that we
Like them, the meek and lowly,
That we will dwell with Thee.

bible_verses.english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it; that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word, that he might present the assembly to himself a glorious assembly, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and blameless.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:
For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being the solid foundation upon which my life and Your Church are built. Thank You for seeking me out and redeeming me with Your precious blood. Help me to love Your global body with the same grace and sacrificial devotion You have shown us. Keep us united in faith, rooted in Your Word, and steadfast in Your love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the world around us feels unpredictable, "The Church's One Foundation" anchors our hearts in the unwavering truth of who Jesus is. Christ did not merely establish the Church; He gave His very life to redeem her, uniting believers across every nation into one holy family. As you sing these words, remember that your identity is securely rooted in His sacrificial love. May this hymn remind you that you belong to a global body held together by the Savior who will never let you go.
